transform_all_constraints: transform all constraints from a traced PyTorch graph into Z3 solver format
transform_to_z3: transform a constraint tree into Z3 logical expressions with dimension encoding
evaluate_conditional_with_constraints: evaluate a conditional node and its negation against generated Z3 constraints
transform_all_constraints_trace_time: generate positive and negated Z3 constraint sets for a trace-time conditional node
iterate_till_fixed_point: iterate constraint transformations until reaching a fixed point for precision matching
